images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 24 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light cool grey concrete background, no person, items only in the lower 76 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: a long light heather grey knit muffler folded loosely, a charcoal grey single-breasted wool tailored blazer laid flat, a black fine-gauge crewneck knit sweater with a white shirt collar peeking out, dark grey washed straight-leg denim jeans, exactly one pair of black leather lace-up ankle boots (only two boots, side by side), and a small silver wristwatch next to them. RIGHT HALF: a full-body street style photo of a slim young Korean man in his 20s wearing exactly the same items: the charcoal blazer open over the black round crewneck knit (round neckline, not V-neck) with white shirt collar, the long heather grey muffler draped around the neck with both ends hanging down the front, dark grey straight jeans, black leather lace-up ankle boots, walking on a quiet Hannam-dong side street with a cafe facade behind, only in the lower 76 percent. Headless body-only framing: the photo is cut at the collarbone, NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair visible at all. Identical items in both halves, realistic wool and denim textures, soft overcast afternoon light, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no signs.
